description.zh: 一个城市的当前天气，定时刷新；断网时留着上一次读数，照样读得懂
description.en: Current conditions for one city, refreshed on a timer and kept readable when the network is gone

help.zh: 填城市名。用的是 Open-Meteo 地理编码给的第一个结果。
help.en: A city name. The first match from Open-Meteo's geocoder is used.

help.zh: Open-Meteo 自己每 15 分钟才更新一次当前天气，问得更勤拿回来的还是同一个数。
help.en: Open-Meteo updates its current conditions every 15 minutes; asking more often returns the same numbers.

items.zh: 在属性面板的「城市」里填一个地名。取的是地理编码的第一个结果，所以写具体一点。
items.en: Type a city into City in the inspector. The first match from Open-Meteo's geocoder wins, so be specific.

items.zh: 组件从不问你的位置 —— 你填哪里，它就只查哪里。
items.en: The widget never asks for your location — you type the place, and only that place is looked up.

items.zh: 不需要 API key：这个服务免费、开放，这个组件能发布出来全靠这一点。
items.en: No API key is involved: the service is free and open, which is the only reason this widget can be published.

items.zh: 「单位」在摄氏配 km/h 和华氏配 mph 之间切。换算是让接口直接按单位返回，这里一个数都不换算。
items.en: Units switches between Celsius with km/h and Fahrenheit with mph. The request asks for them, nothing is converted here.

items.zh: 「刷新间隔」默认 30 分钟，因为 Open-Meteo 自己每 15 分钟才更新一次当前天气。
items.en: Refresh every defaults to 30 minutes, because Open-Meteo itself only updates current conditions every 15.

items.zh: 问得比那更勤，拿回来的还是同一个数 —— 调短不会更准。
items.en: Asking more often than that returns the same numbers, so a shorter interval buys nothing.

items.zh: 上一次读数留在卡片上，顶行标出它是多久之前的，而不是变成一个空框。
items.en: The last reading stays on the card, with a line saying how long ago it was taken, instead of an empty box.

items.zh: 读数按城市和单位分开缓存，两个城市不会互相盖掉。
items.en: Readings are cached per city and per unit, so two cities never overwrite each other's numbers.

items.zh: 「多久之前」那行每分钟刷新一次，即使这一分钟不该拉新数据。
items.en: The age line refreshes every minute even when no new reading is due.

items.zh: 只放行两个主机：地理编码和天气接口。这个组件连不到别的地方。
items.en: Only two hosts are allowed: the geocoder and the forecast service. Nothing else is reachable from this widget.

items.zh: 要是那串名单里少了某个主机，卡片会直接说出来 —— 那是作者写漏了，不是网络抖动。
items.en: If a host were missing from that list the card says so outright — that is an authoring mistake, not a flaky network.

items.zh: 卡片要「联网」和「存储」两项权限：一项用来拉数据，一项用来留住上一次读数。
items.en: The card needs the network and storage permissions: one to fetch, one to keep the last reading.

items.zh: 重新授予之后，下一次刷新就接上，不用重启。
items.en: Grant them again and the next refresh picks up without a restart.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：天气状况、体感 / 风速这些标签、城市与日期、错误话都跟着界面语言走，换语言当场重画。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: conditions, the feels / wind labels, city and dates, and error messages all follow the interface language and repaint on a switch.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：当前天气来自 Open-Meteo，不需要 API key。
changes.en: First release: current conditions from Open-Meteo, with no API key.

changes.zh: 上一次读数按城市和单位缓存，网断了也还剩能读的数字。
changes.en: The last reading is cached per city and unit, so a dropped network leaves readable numbers.

changes.zh: 摄氏或华氏，刷新间隔 15 到 180 分钟。
changes.en: Celsius or Fahrenheit, refreshed between 15 and 180 minutes.
